title: dressupframe
summary: MSUI has a real isolated dressing room whose complete 384x512 geometry and behavior remain rule-owned. DressUpFrameUiLaw owns the portrait, backdrop, model pane, controls, slot mapping, held-lane eviction, ranged-hand split, substitutions, rotation and clamped live animation step. A dedicated CharacterRenderer clones the current player's body and visible melee look without mutating live equipment; its Stand loop and isolated item/enchant effects now advance while the pane is open. Resolved try-ons replace only their visual slot, Reset reclones and Close empties the room. Current equipment-display parity suppresses a hidden worn helm/cloak from the base clone while an explicitly tried-on helm/cloak always previews, matching Benilla's upstream preference application without changing the window layout.

openItems.text: Reference Ctrl-click try-on arms also exist on quest/quest-log reward items, loot and group-loot rows. MSUI's principal chat, bag, paper-doll, inspect and merchant paths are wired, but those secondary item surfaces still need the same DressUpItemLink route where their current interaction models expose an item entry.
openItems.resolution: Quest/quest-log item rows now give Ctrl-click precedence over reward selection, LootFrame rows give it precedence over autostore, and GroupLootFrame icons queue the roll item. These join the existing chat, bag, paper-doll, inspect and merchant routes.

openItems.text: Live-verify representative race/gender backdrops and model crops, the continuously looping Stand pose, initial 0.61 yaw, two-edge 0.06-radian taps, opposite-sign held rotation, base gear cloning, body armor/helm/shoulder/weapon substitutions, bow versus gun hand routing, two-hand eviction, linked-item pending resolution, repeat Ctrl-click accumulation, Reset, both Close controls, painterly rebake, and gameplay-scale seating.

Benilla's DressUpModel is a live PlayerModel widget whose Stand animation loops while the dressing room is open; MSUI froze the renderer and only rebuilt its framebuffer on content or rotation changes.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: the isolated DressUp CharacterRenderer now runs its ordinary Stand clip and the open pane rebakes each frame. DressUpFrameUiLaw owns the resume/stall-safe 50 ms animation-step clamp, Reset/Close clear the wall-clock latch, painterly and item-glow passes remain inside the same model target, and no frame geometry or gameplay-scale behavior changed. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: With Show Helm and Show Cloak disabled, open/reset Dressing Room and confirm the worn base pieces remain hidden; then Ctrl-click a helm and cloak and confirm each explicit substitution previews despite the live preference. Re-enable each preference and confirm Reset reclones the shown worn item.
